summary: Glymph 0.3.2 development, five rounds on 23 development libraries. Cause of the over-cleaning of clean tissue: the xenograft's human immune cells sat in mouse clusters and lost 92 to 99% of their counts. Fix: a cell with far more counts on its cluster's silent genes than background explains is left alone unless those counts follow the background profile and are at most a fifth of the cell. xeno_HSC_3: cells stripped far beyond truth 32 to 1, per-cell error 0.060 to 0.017 (CellBender 0.020). Also a convergence check and a single-cluster fallback in the calibration.
